headline.purpose: Names one operational surface and its outcome.

title.purpose: Names a summary state or evidence region.

label.purpose: Supports compact status, metadata, and controls.

shadows.name: raised-evidence
shadows.purpose: Separates operational evidence cards from the canvas.

motion.name: sidebar-transition
motion.purpose: Moves the persistent sidebar between expanded and collapsed states; reduced motion removes decorative progress movement.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Runs or retries the current Curve task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--background-color-accent-primary); color: var(--text-color-on-color); font: 500 0.75rem/1.25 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--background-color-accent-primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--background-color-accent-primary-active); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Offers a reversible alternative such as cancellation entry or retry.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-strong); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--background-color-layer-2); color: var(--text-color-secondary); box-shadow: 0 1px 6px -1px #292f3d08, 0 1px 4px #292f3d0a; font: 500 0.75rem/1.25 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--background-color-layer-2-hover); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Foundation Status Card
components.description: Pairs the current outcome with its explanation, evidence metadata, and next action.
components.html:
✓

Foundation verified

Curve recorded, orchestrated, and reported the Operation successfully.
components.css: .ds-status-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr); gap: 1.25rem; align-items: center; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-success-subtle); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--background-color-layer-1); color: var(--text-color-primary); box-shadow: 0 1px 6px -1px #292f3d08, 0 1px 4px #292f3d0a; font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-card p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--text-color-secondary); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-status-icon { display: grid; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--background-color-success-subtle); color: var(--text-color-success-primary); }

components.name: Live Connection Pill
components.description: Communicates connection health using text, iconography, and semantic color.
components.html: Updates live
components.css: .ds-connection-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color-success-subtle); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background-color-success-subtle); color: var(--text-color-success-primary); font: 500 0.75rem/1.25 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mobile Workspace Navigation
components.description: A modal Curve-first navigation drawer for viewports below 768px.
components.html: CurveFoundation statusProjects Plane-backed
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { display: flex; width: min(20rem, calc(100vw - 3rem)); min-height: 20rem; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.25rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color-subtle); background: var(--background-color-surface-1); color: var(--text-color-primary); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-nav a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; color: var(--text-color-secondary); text-decoration: none; } .ds-mobile-nav a:hover { background: var(--background-color-layer-1-hover); } .ds-mobile-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--background-color-accent-subtle); color: var(--text-color-accent-primary); } .ds-mobile-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mobile-nav span { font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--text-color-tertiary); }

narrative.overview: Curve presents complex product-delivery infrastructure as a calm, attributable operating surface. The hierarchy leads with the current outcome, action, and evidence; implementation detail remains available in progressive disclosure. Curve owns the product shell and lifecycle language. Plane appears inside that shell as the embedded work-management foundation, with visible attribution. The visual system extends Plane's semantic tokens and Propel components while preserving light, dark, and high-contrast theme behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Curve-first shell ownership with explicit Plane-backed work-management areas.
Neutral layered surfaces with a restrained blue operational accent.
Outcome-first summaries followed by ordered evidence and technical detail.
Status communication that combines language, iconography, and color.
Compact, responsive controls that preserve keyboard and screen-reader behavior.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Curve components consume semantic theme roles; the light, dark, and high-contrast palettes remain centralized in Plane's token system.

rules.name: The Redundant Status Rule
rules.body: Every state uses readable text and an icon in addition to color.

rules.name: The One Outcome Rule
rules.body: Each operational surface has one h1; subsequent headings describe evidence regions rather than restating the page title.

rules.name: The Shell Ownership Rule
rules.body: Curve branding, navigation, breadcrumbs, and lifecycle language frame every enabled Curve workspace; Plane-backed records remain reachable inside the Work management group.

rules.name: The Evidence Above Chrome Rule
rules.body: Elevation distinguishes evidence regions and modal interaction; navigation structure relies primarily on surface and border contrast.

dos: Do lead with the current outcome and next available action.
Do preserve the Curve-first shell around Plane-backed work-management capabilities.
Do derive progress from the current Foundation Operation and its observed delivery evidence.
Do use modal drawer semantics for Curve navigation below 48rem.
Do bind AGPL source attribution to an exact immutable public commit.
donts: Don't use an unrelated Operation as Foundation status or cancellation state.
Don't infer completed workflow or worker stages from cancellation or failure alone.
Don't allow a narrow viewport sidebar to compress the Foundation content.
Don't render a source link for a branch name, short SHA, or missing revision.
Don't present Plane as the owning product shell when Curve is enabled.
